extractImages.title: Extract images from a PDF
extractImages.description: Extract embedded images and download them individually.

extractImages.stepFileDescription: The PDF must contain extractable text; scans without OCR are rejected.
extractImages.stepOutputDescription: Images are shown before any download. No ZIP is downloaded automatically.
extractImages.checkingPdf: Checking whether the PDF is readable…
extractImages.extractedSuccess: Images extracted. Download them individually or choose the ZIP archive.
extractImages.galleryDescription: Click a thumbnail to download that image, or choose the ZIP to download them all.
extractImages.noImagesFound: No embedded images were found in this PDF.
extractImages.unreadablePdf: This PDF is unreadable, password-protected, or invalid and cannot be processed.
extractImages.noTextLayer: No readable text was found. This PDF appears to be a scan without OCR.
extractImages.invalidArchive: The server did not return a valid image archive.
extractImages.emptyArchive: The received image archive is empty.
